title: Subhradip Bhattacharjee
text:
I am a researcher at ICAR - Central Coastal Agricultural Research Institute, Goa, specialising in geospatial analysis and agronomy.
My work focuses on understanding coastal agricultural systems using remote sensing, GIS, and field-based approaches.

title: Subhradip Bhattacharjee
text:

Geospatial analysis of agricultural landscapes

Remote sensing for crop monitoring
Climate impacts on coastal farming systems

title: Why I started this portfolio
text:
This is my first blog post. I am a geospatial and agronomy researcher at ICAR-CCARI, Goa. I created this portfolio to share my research journey, field notes, and short observations that don’t fit into a formal research paper.
Stay tuned for posts on remote sensing, coastal agriculture, and soil health monitoring.
